D: A cat burglar fresh out of prison is recruited to wear a suit that shrinks him to the size of an ant.
P: Serve the snacks when Luis starts one of his very long stories.
S: Luis telling a story that goes on and on
Corn tortillas rolled tight around chicken and cheese, baked until crisp and served with sour cream.
the ants that do all the work
Lavash brushed with oil, sprinkled with black and white sesame seeds in a trail pattern, baked crisp at 180C, with a whipped feta dip.
M: dinner at Hank Pym's old house in San Francisco
Salmon fillets topped with a crust of breadcrumbs, parsley, lemon zest and melted butter, roasted at 220C for 8 minutes, with crushed potatoes and buttered green beans.
Flour tortillas filled with grilled chicken, rice, black beans, cheese, salsa and sour cream, rolled tight and toasted in a dry pan.
W: the ice cream shop job he gets fired from
Scoops of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry.
K: everything shrunk down to ant size
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water with crushed mint, poured into shot glasses on a tray so everything looks shrunk.

s.note: the ants that do all the work
s.how: Brush 2 sheets lavash with olive oil and sprinkle 1 tbsp each black and white sesame seeds in winding trails. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp and snap into shards. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and a little oil for dipping.

s.note: Luis telling a story that goes on and on
s.how: Mix 300g shredded cooked chicken with 100g grated cheddar and 2 tbsp salsa. Roll a spoonful tightly in each of 12 warmed small corn tortillas, brush with oil and bake seam-side down at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp. Serve with sour cream.

m.how: Grill 600g chicken thighs and slice. Cook 200g rice. Fill 4 large flour tortillas with chicken, rice, a tin of black beans, 100g cheddar, salsa and sour cream. Roll tight and toast in a dry pan.

w.note: the ice cream shop job he gets fired from
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream into four bowls. Pour over the fudge and add whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry.

d.note: everything shrunk down to ant size
d.how: Dissolve 120g sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 4 lemons, crushed mint and 750ml cold water. Pour into shot glasses on a tray so everything looks shrunk.
